detail.longDescription: The riskiest moment for an agent platform is just after deploy. In AWS Labs' Loom before 1.6.1, a backend with no identity provider set gave every request, even one with no Authorization header, a super-admin identity. CVSS 10. A fresh install was an open admin panel. The fix makes no-auth mode an explicit opt-in that only answers loopback. Missing config should fail closed. https:// github.com/awslabs/loom/securi ty/advisories/GHSA-vgmj-998f-r8mp # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # DevOps
